tasks.title: Audited application and persistent local root
tasks.deliverable: Repository, stack/access ADR, dependency inventory, migrations/launcher/config and isolation.

tasks.title: Canonical catalogue, sources and metric/outcome schema
tasks.deliverable: Versioned identities, source policies, observations, outcomes and relationship invariants.

tasks.title: Reviewed real Spotify importer and exports
tasks.deliverable: Preview/resolve/commit/undo uploader with exact supplied fixtures and provenance.

tasks.title: Campaign UI, dialog primitive and calendar execution
tasks.deliverable: Three campaign types, manual/operational dated work, typed navigation and real persistence.

tasks.title: Outcome dashboard and recovery
tasks.deliverable: Real compatible progress/coverage, Today basics, backup/restore smoke and restart.

tasks.title: Early time-safe evaluation scaffolding
tasks.deliverable: Dataset manifest, availability/prospective ledger, synthetic baselines/splits and precise source-use gate.

tasks.title: Authorised Meta route and capability probe
tasks.deliverable: Real account/API/metric/timezone report; pending credentials leave live status Blocked.

tasks.title: Idempotent collector and source health
tasks.deliverable: Leased jobs, pagination/snapshots/retries/retention/recovery with real supported data.

tasks.title: Reviewed context and curated peers
tasks.deliverable: Conservative rules/identity review, versioned cohort and allowed public data path.

tasks.title: Reproducible findings, observation drill-down and timing
tasks.deliverable: Eligible bundles/coarse window comparisons and stable Evidence tabs/source navigation.

tasks.title: Contextual inspiration and scoped reports
tasks.deliverable: Global/contextual reference attach, presave/ticket reviewed contracts/manual observations.

tasks.title: Artist-wide dashboard and source acceptance
tasks.deliverable: Real trend/freshness/due alerts and sanitised source health/live proof.

tasks.title: Evidence-backed candidate selection and support
tasks.deliverable: Versioned candidate catalogue/eligibility/ranking, explicit transfer limits and abstention.

tasks.title: Shared capacity and temporal scheduler
tasks.deliverable: Constrained dates/time/zone, SchedulingDecision, conservative fallbacks and manual overrides.

tasks.title: Creation review, practical briefs and approvals
tasks.deliverable: Release/growth/show generated draft, concise review, Why/Timing/source and atomic selected acceptance.

tasks.title: Audited local semantic and synthesis adapter
tasks.deliverable: Model/runner inventory, frozen permitted benchmark, schema/policy validation and fallback; enable only passing tasks.

tasks.title: Experiment lifecycle and reviewed adaptations
tasks.deliverable: Frozen protocols, mature outcome review, invalidation/event proposals, fingerprints and diff decisions.

tasks.title: Grounded Ask and full creative walkthrough
tasks.deliverable: Evidence-limited assistant, proposed edits, no tools/publication; three-scenario owner review.

tasks.title: Full browser/accessibility and state qualification
tasks.deliverable: Actual geometry/focus/keyboard/zoom/longtext/error matrix for all screens.

tasks.title: Operations, deletion, migration and concurrency qualification
tasks.deliverable: File DB race/recovery/backup/restore/upgrade/deletion and sanitised diagnostics.

tasks.title: Numerical forecast evaluation or explicit readiness report
tasks.deliverable: Real candidate evaluation only after rights/history gate; otherwise preserved Blocked/Insufficient status and report.

tasks.title: Live connector and model release inventory
tasks.deliverable: Runtime/capability/purpose/dependency/model evidence with enabled/disabled capabilities accurately declared.

tasks.title: Release package and owner acceptance
tasks.deliverable: Pinned build, install/update/rollback/backup docs, full acceptance report and concrete final owner review.
